agentsTab.description: Registry of agents supported by the platform, read-only.

agentView.title: {{agent}} configuration
agentView.description: Environment variables injected only into this agent's processes (they take precedence over global variables).

languageTab.title: Agent languages
languageTab.description: Default languages sent to agents at launch. An explicit request from the user or the project's conventions always takes precedence.

documentation.label: Documentation language
documentation.hint: Generated documentation and OpenSpec artifacts (proposal, design, specs, tasks).

code.label: Code language
code.hint: Identifiers, comments, commit messages, error messages and visible text.

columnsTab.description: Agent, model and reasoning effort used for each kind of agent launch. An empty field inherits from the row above; the global row is the base for every role.

roleSettings.fixerNote: Only applies to a worker restarted after "Request corrections" in the review. The self-healing loop keeps the Implementation settings.
roleSettings.modelUnsupported: The model flag of this agent's CLI is not validated by the platform, so the model cannot be set.

poolSettings.title: Agent Pool defaults
poolSettings.description: Values the launch dialog is pre-filled with. You can still adjust them for a single launch.
poolSettings.sizeInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 5.
poolSettings.attemptsInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 10.
